question: How should AI edits and streaming reuse authored commands, selection and application policy?
trigger: Reporter regression: green AI output, missing generation indicator, and an unsolicited switch from Editing to Suggestion; final adoption review after the bounded redesign.
requirements: Temporary generation, review, retry and cancellation preserve the actual user intent and leave source document/history untouched.
Purple rich inline or selection previews have a visible stream-end indicator; discard restores mapped native input and accept places the caret for subsequent typing.
Apply uses normal commands in one history batch, respects explicit Suggestion mode, preserves unrelated edits, and rejects deleted or retired targets.
Reuse canonical Markdown, native anchors, node keys, sparse keyed rendering and existing static preview owners before adding a public primitive.
Final native Chrome replay, exact browser assertions and complete-operation scaling gates must support closure; retain failed and blocked proof.
evidenceReuse: Reused the immutable ownership review, observed main-source AI paint and the earlier valid authored key/history repairs. Rechecked final production package output, native Chrome behavior, all eight AI browser cases, lifecycle retirement, selected-text edits, structured table targets and the existing rich Markdown fixtures. Three fresh-process samples per six production-path scale cohorts passed frozen gates against the immutable source-built baseline.
summary: Adopt one temporary AI draft and one ordinary apply; remove proposal preview coupling, mode switching and partial-Markdown feedback.
alternatives: Color override or restored AI marks: insufficient because the mode switch and persistent suggestion lifetime remain.
A filtered authored branch, origin flag or edit/markup extension: adds projection and routing ownership that the current job does not require; the measured reuse candidate passes.

Existing previewValue/static AIChatEditor plus mapped native targets and one apply: adopted. It deletes dual application paths, AI authored dependencies, view snapshots, mode-switch microtasks and per-chunk document mutation.
proofLimits: Bounded preview-ownership adoption, not an exhaustive AI/Copilot audit. Final browser: eight passes in 42.3 s, full MDX 3996 ms and maximum frame gap 66.6 ms on a local source-first dev server. Package scale costs are separate: 100 KiB/1000 blocks median 10.28 s versus baseline 37.55 s; maximum publish 39.14 ms. Broad type gates remain blocked by existing authored project-reference errors and unrelated comment/history test contracts. Main was inspected as local source, not replayed end to end. The interrupted registry-generation browser run does not count. Review performed sequentially without an independent reviewer.
